import json, subprocess, sys

    def __init__(self):
        self.cmds=[]; self.notes=[]; self.rev=0; self.now=0; self.expect=[]
    def send(self, c, note="", expect=None):
        self.cmds.append(c); self.notes.append(note); self.expect.append(expect)
    def set(self, rev=None, now=None):
        if rev is not None: self.rev=rev
        if now is not None: self.now=now

t=T()
t.send({"op":"about"}, "about", {"status":"ok","protocol":"forest-controller/3"})

lines=[json.dumps(c) for c,_ in t.cmds]
out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B","submission/main.py"],input="\n".join(lines)+"\n",capture_output=True,text=True)
replies=[json.loads(x) for x in out.stdout.splitlines()]
bad=0
for i,((c,note),r) in enumerate(zip(t.cmds,replies)):
    exp = t.expect[i]
    ok = True
    if exp is not None:
        ok = (r == exp)
    if note.startswith(("compile pA","replay pA","fresh commit","replay commit","audit lease","cancel ok","cut denial","replay denied","advance","force","nonforced","capacity denial")):
        print(f"[{i}] {note}: {json.dumps(r)[:300]}")
    if not ok:
        print(f"[{i}] MISMATCH {note}\n   cmd={json.dumps(c)}\n   got={json.dumps(r)}\n   exp={json.dumps(exp)}"); bad+=1
print("bad:",bad,"lines:",len(replies),len(t.cmds))
